projects.name: consentpath
projects.description: A multi-site clinical trial enrolment app where authorisation is decided by the data layer through security views keyed on session claims. The reference design is PostgreSQL row-level security; this repo models it with SQLite views. A negative-authorisation test matrix proves the denials.
highlights: 32-case matrix across 4 roles x 2 sites x 4 participants, asserting denial as well as permit
Column-level blinding of arm assignment and consent-gated genomic export
16 tests, plus an append-only access log enforced by triggers

projects.name: controlmap
projects.description: SOC 2 evidence automation that collects exports from GitHub, AWS, identity and HR systems, evaluates YAML controls mapped to the Trust Services Criteria, and builds a hashed evidence package an auditor can verify. It supports an audit and does not replace one.
highlights: 6 built-in collectors and 22 built-in rules
Controls validated against 61 TSC criteria ids and 93 ISO 27001 Annex A controls
Evidence package with a checksum manifest, checkable with shasum

projects.name: realtime-stock-market-pipeline
projects.description: A real-time stock market analytics pipeline that ingests prices from Polygon.io and Alpha Vantage through Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming. It serves a Grafana dashboard with Z-score anomaly alerts and runs a daily batch reconciliation of stream against batch totals.
highlights: Rolling 1min, 5min and 1hr OHLCV windows with Z-score anomaly detection on price and volume
Daily Airflow reconciliation comparing stream and batch totals
12 unit tests passing across 3 test suites

projects.name: cannibal
projects.description: Search cannibalisation detection that tests every within-query page pair for genuine competition and corrects for multiple testing. The output is a short list of real competing pairs instead of hundreds of noisy ones.
highlights: One site: 173 uncorrected flags (161 false) against 14 with Benjamini-Hochberg (2 false)
3,575 page pairs tested; all 12 planted pairs found
Pure standard-library Python, with a seeded generator that measures precision

projects.name: contextlens
projects.description: A VS Code extension that shows who wrote a line, why, and what the PR discussion said, in a hover card. It follows the blame to the pull request, ranks comments by how well they explain the change, and caches them locally.
highlights: Local SQLite cache makes repeat hovers instant and available offline
Rate-limit-aware GitHub client with Retry-After and exponential backoff
GitHub token kept in VS Code SecretStorage, never in settings

projects.name: provenance-gate
projects.description: A SLSA provenance verifier that checks signed attestations against policy, then rebuilds the artifact and diffs it to show the binary came from the reviewed source rather than trusting the attestation alone.
highlights: Rejects with 9 specific reason codes, including DIGEST_MISMATCH, REPLAYED and NOT_REPRODUCIBLE
19 tests covering the genuine path and each tamper class
Python standard library only, with a browser demo of the decision workflow

projects.name: squatwatch
projects.description: An offline detector for typosquats, dependency-confusion exposure and risky install hooks in npm and PyPI dependencies. Every finding names the technique and the popular package it resembles, and results come with CI-friendly exit codes.
highlights: Checks names against about 12,000 popular PyPI projects and 14,000 npm packages
Outputs text, JSON or SARIF 2.1.0 for CI
Static review of setup.py, npm lifecycle scripts and wheel .pth files without executing them

projects.name: passkeyd
projects.description: A Go WebAuthn (passkey) relying-party library and HTTP server with its own CBOR decoder, COSE key parser and a software authenticator for testing. Every rejection carries a stable code naming the check that stopped it.
highlights: 34 typed verification checks, each with a negative test
Replays all 11 WebAuthn Level 3 credential vectors and 82 CBOR examples
Threat model mapping 19 threats to mitigations and tests
